model: ACQ580 water and wastewater drive (embedded Modbus RTU)
applies_to: ACQ580 drives running the ACQ580 pump control program, embedded fieldbus (EFB) Modbus RTU, addressing mode 0 (default); firmware manual 3AXD50000035867 Rev H.
summary: ABB's water and wastewater pump drive with a built-in RS-485 port that speaks Modbus RTU. The first six holding registers carry the control word, two references, status word and two actual values; every parameter is also a holding register derived from its group and index. This map covers the cyclic block, the error registers, key 01/04/05 monitoring parameters, the comm-loss settings and the main 32-bit actual values.
firmware: ACQ580 pump control program, manual revision H

addressing.note: The manual prints holding registers as 6-digit references and maps 400001-465536 onto the 65536-register address field, so 400001 = wire address 0 (its setup table also pairs the parameter range with addresses 100-65535). Masters limited to 5 digits can use 40001-49999 for 400001-409999; 32-bit parameter registers (420000+) need 6-digit or raw addressing. With 58.33 Addressing mode = Mode 0 (default) a 16-bit parameter gg.ii sits at 400000 + 100*gg + ii (e.g. 01.11 -> 400111, wire 110) and a 32-bit copy at 420000 + 200*gg + 2*ii (e.g. 01.07 -> 420214, wire 20213). Mode 1 uses 400000 + 256*gg + ii and Mode 2 uses 400000 + 512*gg + 2*ii; this map assumes Mode 0. All 32-bit registers are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI, the default.

source.title: ACQ580 pump control program firmware manual
source.pages: EFB setup pp. 239-240; control/status words pp. 246-251; start/stop p. 255; holding register table p. 258; error registers p. 265; parameters 01/04/05 pp. 301-309; group 58 pp. 515-522; Additional parameter data (FbEq32) pp. 607-609

notes: Registers 400001-400006 are the factory defaults of Data I/O 1-6 (58.101-58.106) and can be re-pointed; 400007-400014 are user-selectable via 58.107-58.114 and are not listed.

Control and status word bits are shown for the ABB Drives profile (58.25 = 0, default). With the DCU profile (58.25 = 5) the words are passed through unconverted with a different bit layout (bit 0 STOP, bit 1 START, bit 2 REVERSE, bit 4 RESET...).

Reference/actual registers are signed 16-bit; 20000 corresponds to the value of 46.01 Speed scaling or 46.02 Frequency scaling (46.03 torque, 46.04 power), so their engineering value depends on drive settings and is left unscaled here.
32-bit registers use 58.34 Word order; the default LO-HI sends the low word first (CDAB). If 58.34 is set to HI-LO the order becomes ABCD. Within each register the high byte is sent first.

16-bit parameter scaling is the manual's FbEq16 column (e.g. '10 = 1 V' -> scale 0.1); 32-bit scaling is the FbEq32 column in the Additional parameter data chapter. Parameters whose 16-bit scaling is 'See par. 46.xx' (01.01 speed, 01.06 frequency, 01.07 current, 01.10 torque, 01.14 power, 01.72-01.74 phase currents) are listed only in their 32-bit form.

Left out: 06.xx control/status/inhibit words (bit lists not re-checked for this drive), 01.50-01.53 hour/day kWh logs, group 46 scaling parameters and configuration parameters other than the comm-loss settings.
Coils (CW bits) and discrete inputs (SW bits, DI status) also exist but are omitted: the manual's wording on how their references map to wire addresses is ambiguous.
If 96.78 Legacy Modbus mapping (ACS550/ACx550 compatibility) is enabled, the register layout changes and this map no longer applies.
Unlike the ACS480/ACS580, the ACQ580 lists 01.66 Abs output power % motor nom as '10 = 1%' (0.1 % steps) in 16-bit form.
58.16 Communication loss time is '1 = 1 s' in this manual, so it is listed in whole seconds.
The EFB setup table shows 58.16 = 30.0 s as default, while the parameter list shows 10.0 s; both agree on 58.14 = No action and 58.15 = Cw / Ref1 / Ref2. Read them back from the drive.

registers.name: Control word (EFB CW)
registers.description: ABB Drives profile bits shown; DCU profile layout differs (58.25).

bits.0: OFF1_CONTROL: 1 = ready to operate, 0 = ramp stop (OFF1)
bits.1: OFF2_CONTROL: 0 = emergency OFF, coast to stop
bits.4: RAMP_OUT_ZERO: 0 = force ramp output to zero
bits.6: RAMP_IN_ZERO: 0 = force ramp input to zero
bits.10: REMOTE_CMD: 1 = fieldbus control (manual text truncated to 'Fieldbus control d.'); 0 = last CW/reference kept unless both are 0

integration.summary: Enable Modbus RTU in group 58, point the start/stop and reference sources at the embedded fieldbus, then write the ABB Drives control word and Reference 1 at 400001/400002 and poll the status word and actual values at 400004-400006. Read further monitoring values straight from their parameter registers (400000 + 100*group + index).
integration.enable: Set 58.01 Protocol enable = Modbus RTU, then 58.03 node address, 58.04 baud and 58.05 parity, and apply them with 58.06 Communication control = Refresh settings (or power-cycle). For control set 20.01 Ext1 commands (and 20.06 for EXT2) = Embedded fieldbus and the reference source, e.g. 22.11 Ext1 speed ref1 or 28.11 Ext1 frequency ref1 = EFB ref1. Every start/stop control-word value in the manual sets bit 10 (REMOTE_CMD); the manual's own description of that bit is truncated. Save parameter writes permanently with 96.07 Parameter save manually.
integration.watchdog: 58.14 Communication loss action (No action by default / Fault / Last speed / Speed ref safe / Fault always / Warning) with 58.16 Communication loss time (0-6000 s) and 58.15 Communication loss mode (default: only control word/reference writes reset the timer). A loss trips 6681 EFB comm loss or warns A7CE; 'Speed ref safe' runs at 22.41/28.41. There is a 30 s boot-up delay before monitoring starts.
quirks: Addresses are 6-digit Modicon references: 400001 = wire 0. 32-bit parameter registers start at 420000 and cannot be reached with 5-digit (4xxxx) addressing.
32-bit values in this map are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI (the default: low word first). If 58.34 is set to HI-LO, read them as ABCD.
References and actual values are signed 16-bit with 20000 = the 46.01/46.02 scaling value, not engineering units.
Only the lower 16 bits of the drive's 32-bit control/status words are visible at 400001/400004.

Start (manual's sequence): write 0x0476 (1142); once status bit 0 (RDY_ON) is 1, write 0x047E (1150) and then 0x047F (1151) to run. Stop: 0x0477 (1143) stops per 21.03 Stop mode; 0x047E (1150) OFF1 ramp stop; 0x047D (1149) OFF2 coast; 0x047B (1147) OFF3 emergency ramp. Fault reset: rising edge of control-word bit 7.
setup: Wire the RS-485 link per the drive's hardware manual; the control unit has switches for bus termination and bias resistors.
Defaults: node 1, 19.2 kbit/s, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit (58.03-58.05); baud can also be set to Autodetect.
Changes to group 58 take effect only after 58.06 = Refresh settings or a control-unit reboot.
58.07 Communication diagnostics flags init/address errors, parity and baud errors, no bus activity, noise/addressing errors and comm loss; 58.08-58.12 count packets and errors.
gotchas: If a start command is ignored, check 06.18 Start inhibit status word on the panel (for example a missing run permissive or STO).
Pump-program features (sleep, PID, multipump) can stop or start the pump on their own; check the active control mode before blaming the bus.
If legacy (ACx550) Modbus mapping is enabled the register layout changes and this map no longer applies.
Exception 04h means the request was rejected by the drive; read 400092 Error code for the reason (e.g. limit exceeded).

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
